call.content:
Security review — origin/main..HEAD in shop
1 high, 1 medium, 0 low: fix first

## Findings
1. high — shop/export.py:30 — the request's `fmt` field is joined into a shell command — injection
2. medium — shop/routes/public.py:30 — GET /orders/{id} no longer filters by the signed-in user — missing authorisation

## Fixes
1. shop/export.py:30 — `subprocess.run(["zip", "-r", f"out.{fmt}", path], check=True)` after `if fmt not in {"zip", "tar"}: raise ValueError(fmt)`
2. shop/routes/public.py:30 — restore `user_id=current_user.id` in the filter

## Safe
- shop/routes/admin.py:2 — `fmt` comes from a form field behind the admin login; the login is intact, which is why finding 1 is high and not critical

## Verdict
- fix first — finding 1 is reachable by any admin with the export page; finding 2 by any signed-in user. Not covered: nothing; the diff is 2 files.

script.say:

## Report
- read the diff (2 files) and 2 call sites; wrote "Security review — origin/main..HEAD in shop"
